task: Install a whole-home water leak sensor/shutoff
steps: Place point sensors near water heaters, washing machines, and under sinks.
For a whole-home automatic shutoff valve, it installs inline on the main water line.
If comfortable with plumbing and low-voltage wiring, this can be a DIY project; otherwise hire a plumber.
Connect the system to Wi-Fi and pair sensors with the shutoff valve/app.
Test by simulating a leak (a wet paper towel on a sensor) to confirm alerts and auto-shutoff work.
